Our 2016 Spring Equinox celebration was held on Sunday March 20th in Redmond and Gatineau. We added board games as a new element, with the West Coast contingent playing [http://www.northstargames.com/products/evolution Evolution] and the Saumurs playing [https://diceygoblin.com/blog/terra-mystica-fire-ice-review/ Terra Mystica: Fire & Ice].
